notes.title: Deal&Wheler Big Update
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Deal&Wheler Is Completely Changing[/h3][/b]

From its character to its story, from driving dynamics to in-game events, we're renewing it all. We apologize for the delayed update during this time and thank you for your patience.

[h3]Game Map and Menu[/h3]

The map in the game is being replaced by a completely new city map. The menu design, which negatively affects the user experience, is being redesigned.

[h3][b]Professions[/b][/h3]

More than one profession, such as truck driver, taxi driver, street racer, and investor, which you can do in the game other than buying and selling cars, will be waiting for you.

[h1][h3][b]Vehicles and Driving Dynamics[/b][/h3][/h1]

Now vehicles can be dirtied, customized in performance and appearance, and used in races. In addition, systems such as Repairman and Tunning are also added to the game.

[h3][b]Developments[/b][/h3]

All items in the game, from your character to your gallery, from the parking lot you bought, from the staff to the car wash, will be upgradeable with money. In addition, the character's ability system and combat mechanics are among the new items to be added.

[h3][b]Finally[/b][/h3]

We hope you wait patiently for the next big update. Estimated update time will be between 2-3 months. In this process, we will answer all your questions by sharing in-game images to keep you informed of the developments. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Bugfix and Sleep System Update
notes.notes:
- The Sleep System has been updated. Now you can choose how many hours you want to sleep

- Bugs in the parking lot and throughout the game have been fixed. It works more stable now.

- Quests will no longer disappear after 1 completion and will not be repeated.

- Some adjustments have been made in vehicle driving dynamics.

- You can now join the race event after 20:00.

notes.title: May Updates
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Adding New City Map[/b][/h1]

[img]https://r.resimlink.com/jBt5OM.png[/img]

[img]https://r.resimlink.com/SJXiy.png[/img]

A brand new map is waiting for you, where you can take your business experience to a more professional level by having enough money and fame. In addition, with the new map, new content, missions and professions will be among the experiences you can experience

[b][h1]You Can Become a Truck Driver[/h1][/b]

[img]https://r.resimlink.com/p4izoR.png[/img]

[img]https://r.resimlink.com/G5d2T7aXx0.png[/img]

Now, the profession of truck driver, where you can earn money and have a good time, will also be accessible. However, in order to have a truck driver's license, a series of exams will be waiting for you. Good luck.

[h1][b]Digital Marketplace Vendor[/b][/h1]

We are also bringing a new platform where you can earn additional income in the game. A system where you can buy and sell second-hand items over the computer will be active and you will make profitable trade by trying to sell the items you bought at the best offer.

[b][h1]Bugs and Errors[/h1][/b]

We are aware of some mouse, fps and in-game issues that occur in early access and negatively affect your gaming experience, and we are working hard to fix them with updates as soon as possible. We also bring the new system where you can wake up at any time in the game. It is very important for us that you support us with your feedback during this time.

notes.title: BugFix and Game Editing Update V2
notes.notes:
- The problem of importing parking vehicles has been resolved. In addition, the elements were a determining factor in the frequency of vehicles coming to the parking lot.
- Turkish/English language translation problems have been fixed.
- Arrangements have been made for the vehicles that can be purchased via conversation over the computer.
- Fixed the problem of not opening the map and navigation while on the bike.
- Fixed some lighting issues.
- Fixed some customers' bidding issues.
- Adjustments to air dynamics have been made.

notes.title: Language and Bug Fix Update
notes.notes: Added English language option and fixed some critical bugs. Played on bugs checking gameplay. More in-game content and additions will be made regularly and you are expected to have a better in-game experience.
